## What changed since `fork-2026.09.25-af3c1b9`

**Runs**
- Every row of the run configurations list has its own Run, Restart and Stop,
  so several configurations are started and stopped one after another without
  closing the list. "Restart all" and "Stop all" act on every run at once, and
  the plaque says how many are running.

**zedcli**
- `zedcli run`, `stop` and `restart` are back and take several names at once,
  or `--running` for everything the window runs.
- The API Client is managed from the shell: create, rename, move and delete
  collections, folders and saved requests; `api show` a request in full; send
  one with one-off changes (`-X`, `-H`, `--query`, `-d`); print it as code in
  curl, Python, Go, JavaScript and eight more, in the editor's colours. Any
  HTTP method is sent. Credentials and secret variables are masked.
- zedcli presents a token the editor writes at start-up, and
  `"zedcli": { "enabled": false }` turns it off. Databases stay read-only.

**Terminal**
- Selecting text with the mouse copies it to the clipboard when the button is
  released (`terminal.copy_on_select`, now on by default).

**Database Explorer**
- A new MySQL connection starts with SSL Require, which MySQL 8 needs for its
  default authentication. A read-only MongoDB or Redis connection accepts its
  own read commands again.
